method: Hand review of design/parity/evidence/<row>/comparison.png (reference, built, pixelmatch diff) against Material Design 3 component anatomy and the checked-in reference.

primitives.finding: Tiles are now the reference four (Health score, Breached, Needs work, Healthy) in order; the breach tile states its figure is unknown rather than showing a count (repaired 2026-09-01).
Cards stack in one column with the reference header anatomy (tonal glyph circle, title over blurb, count pill, chevron); expanded cards list entry rows with a Fix action (repaired 2026-09-01).
Headline dropped and the export is a Material outlined button beside the search pill (repaired 2026-09-02); the category select and the Detailed reports route stay as recorded deviations.

deviations.reason: The built header keeps a findings category select (a real filter over the finding cards, searchable like every select) and a Detailed reports button that reaches the classic report dialogs still needed for the offline breach corpus; the reference has neither.
deviations.approval: Reviewed 2026-09-02: both are functional routes, not chrome, and stay until the classic reports are Material.
